system_prompt_patterns.name: empty_system_prompt
system_prompt_patterns.description: System prompt is empty or not set; all 30 records have no valid system prompt
examples: All records have empty system role content

system_prompt_patterns.name: default_claude_identity
system_prompt_patterns.description: Relies on model's default identity setting, assumed to be a professional assistant role
examples: No explicit system prompt definition, model uses built-in identity

system_prompt_patterns.name: role_adaptation_by_query
system_prompt_patterns.description: Model adaptively assumes corresponding expert roles based on user query type
examples: Automatic switching between technical implementation, academic explanation, business consulting scenarios

system_prompt_patterns.name: minimal_general_assistant_role
system_prompt_patterns.description: System Prompt uses minimalist setup, defining AI identity with only 'You are a helpful AI assistant.', no specific domain limitations or special behavioral constraints
examples: You are a helpful AI assistant.

system_prompt_patterns.name: no_boundary_constraints
system_prompt_patterns.description: No behavioral boundaries, ethical constraints, or specific scenario rules defined; role setting is completely open

system_prompt_patterns.name: general_capability_implication
system_prompt_patterns.description: 'helpful' implies AI should have multi-domain problem-solving capabilities, applicable to various tasks

system_prompt_patterns.name: no_conversation_history_preset
system_prompt_patterns.description: System Prompt does not contain conversation history or context presets; each conversation is independent interaction

system_prompt_patterns.name: no_style_guidance
system_prompt_patterns.description: No specified response style, format preferences, or language tone; AI has full autonomy in style decisions

system_prompt_patterns.name: no_valid_system_prompt_data
system_prompt_patterns.description: All samples have messages array first element with role='unknown' and content empty; cannot identify valid system prompt role definition

system_prompt_patterns.name: no_explicit_system_prompt
system_prompt_patterns.description: Dataset almost entirely lacks role=system messages; AI role behavior is entirely determined by conversation context and task type
examples: Model self-infers need to answer as expert
Only user and assistant messages, no independent system prompt

system_prompt_patterns.name: professional_problem_solver_identity
system_prompt_patterns.description: AI is set as a knowledge expert in professional domains, capable of handling various problem types: math, science, programming, translation
examples: Answering chemistry questions (ammonia water effect on aluminum)

system_prompt_patterns.name: explanatory_educator_role
system_prompt_patterns.description: Not only provides answers but also explains reasoning process in detail; acts as educator to help users understand

system_prompt_patterns.name: task_oriented_role
system_prompt_patterns.description: AI is set as task-oriented role: math calculation, code writing, translation, logical reasoning, etc.

system_prompt_patterns.name: verification_analysis_role
system_prompt_patterns.description: Conducts multi-angle verification before giving conclusions to ensure answer accuracy and reliability

system_prompt_patterns.name: implicit_behavioral_constraints
system_prompt_patterns.description: Behavioral rules are implicitly defined through user query; model self-infers boundaries
examples: SEO/legal advice will note 'not legal advice'

system_prompt_patterns.name: disclaimer_inclusion
system_prompt_patterns.description: Professional domains (legal, medical) responses automatically include disclaimers
examples: not a substitute for professional medical advice

system_prompt_patterns.name: non_judgmental_attitude
system_prompt_patterns.description: For sensitive or personal questions, maintain non-judgmental attitude, provide useful information rather than moralizing
examples: No moral judgment, provide practical advice
About sexual fantasies: 'I'm not here to shame anyone's consensual adult activities'

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: single_turn_query_response
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: Standard single-turn Q&A pattern: one user message, one complete assistant response

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: chain_of_think_reasoning
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: Use <think> tags to wrap reasoning process, display thinking chain

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: variable_response_length
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: Response length varies greatly, from 229 characters to 133,713 characters

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: query_complexity_response_depth
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: User query complexity positively correlates with response depth
examples: Simple math problem (229 chars) vs comprehensive GTM plan (101k chars)

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: message_structure_missing
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: All conversation records contain only 2 messages, both with role='unknown', content='' invalid state

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: domain_field_distribution
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: metadata.domain field shows samples cover instruction_following and code two domains

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: CoT_thinking_tag_pattern
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: Assistant response contains <thinking> tag wrapped thinking chain process; analysis inside tag, conclusion outside tag
examples:
<thinking>Let me work through this problem step by step...</thinking>
## Solution

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: structured_step_expansion
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: Use Step 1/2/3 or First/Then/Finally markers to organize response content, presenting clear logical progression
examples: Step 1: Calculate..., Step 2: Determine..., Step 3: Calculate...

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: concise_two_turn_dialogue
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: Most common dialogue pattern: user raises single question, AI gives complete answer, usually user-assistant two-turn dialogue

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: answer_first_then_explain
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: First directly give answer (bold or boxed), then provide detailed reasoning and verification process

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: simple_qa_pattern
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: Most basic single-turn dialogue structure: user asks -> AI answers, no multi-turn interaction

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: example_verification_pattern
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: After explaining concepts, provide specific numerical examples for verification, commonly using table comparisons

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: scaffolded_explanation_structure
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: Complex topics use layered structure: overview -> details -> examples/practice
examples: Diabetes overview divided into pathophysiology/diagnostics/management modules

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: multi_independent_subquestions
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: Single assistant response handles multiple independent sub-questions or option analysis
examples: Option A analysis... Option B analysis... Option C analysis... Final conclusion

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: code_response_length_correlation
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: Responses containing code are usually longer; technical implementation responses have largest length
examples: Code implementation responses average over 20k characters

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: chain_of_thought_expansion
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: Decompose complex problems into multiple steps, display reasoning process sequentially, applicable to math and logic problems

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: verification_confirmation_pattern
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: Add verification step before final answer; confirm result correctness through reverse calculation or multiple methods

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: table_presentation
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: Use table structure to organize information, enhancing answer readability and organization

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: request_clarification_pattern
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: When user input is incomplete or vague, AI proactively requests additional information
examples: It appears that the system of equations you want me to solve was not included

dialogue_structure_patterns.name: refuse_then_redirect_pattern
dialogue_structure_patterns.description: For inappropriate requests, first refuse then redirect, providing alternative positive help direction
examples: I'm not going to engage with... If you have a legitimate question...

language_style_atoms.name: no_available_language_data
language_style_atoms.description: All content fields empty; cannot analyze tone, sentence structure, or vocabulary preferences

language_style_atoms.name: formal_academic_tone
language_style_atoms.description: Use formal, academic language style, avoid colloquial expressions

language_style_atoms.name: guiding_opening
language_style_atoms.description: Common openings: 'Let me analyze', 'Let me work through', 'Let me think' to indicate analysis start
examples: Let me break down this problem
Let me analyze this problem step by step
Let me think through this carefully

language_style_atoms.name: markdown_formatting
language_style_atoms.description: Extensive use of Markdown syntax: headers (##), tables (| | |), code blocks (```), bold (**)

language_style_atoms.name: let_me_introductory_phrase
language_style_atoms.description: Use 'Let me' as action-oriented response opener, indicating specific help will be provided
examples: Let me create a complete solution

language_style_atoms.name: mathematical_expression_direct
language_style_atoms.description: Embed mathematical operations directly as equations in sentences, rather than describing calculation process separately

language_style_atoms.name: heading_title_format
language_style_atoms.description: Extensive use of Markdown headers to organize content, unified header style

language_style_atoms.name: concise_direct_tone
language_style_atoms.description: Neutral, concise response tone, no superfluous emotional coloring, direct to the point

language_style_atoms.name: progressive_elaboration
language_style_atoms.description: Use progressive expressions: concept -> principle -> implementation -> optimization

language_style_atoms.name: verification_confirmation_mark
language_style_atoms.description: Use check mark symbols, 'Verification:', 'Verify:' labels to emphasize verification step completion

language_style_atoms.name: formal_academic_tone_overall
language_style_atoms.description: Overall tone is formal, professional, using academic expressions

language_style_atoms.name: professional_formal_vocabulary
language_style_atoms.description: Use professional terminology and precise mathematical vocabulary: 'calculate', 'total', 'percentage', 'dimension'

language_style_atoms.name: technical_jargon_integration
language_style_atoms.description: Embed domain-specific terminology: framework/algorithm/protocol
examples: framework: 12 times, algorithm: 6 times, protocol: 4 times

language_style_atoms.name: mathematical_formula_embedding
language_style_atoms.description: Use LaTeX format to embed mathematical formulas and symbols, such as $Q = mc\Delta T$

language_style_atoms.name: domain_specific_terminology
language_style_atoms.description: Use corresponding professional terminology based on problem domain: amphoteric, delocalization, bipartite matching

language_style_atoms.name: markdown_formatting_wide
language_style_atoms.description: Use Markdown syntax to enhance structural sense: bold, headers, lists

language_style_atoms.name: guiding_transition_words
language_style_atoms.description: Use 'first', 'then', 'next', 'finally' to build step sequence feeling

language_style_atoms.name: here_is_directive
language_style_atoms.description: Use 'Here's' or similar structure to directly present content

language_style_atoms.name: passive_voice_usage
language_style_atoms.description: Use passive voice when describing objective facts, emphasizing results rather than agent

language_style_atoms.name: numbered_point_statement
language_style_atoms.description: Decompose complex information into independent numbered or bulleted list items, explain one by one

language_style_atoms.name: collaborative_personal_pronouns
language_style_atoms.description: Use first person to build rapport: 'I think'/'I believe' to express opinions

language_style_atoms.name: uncertainty_expression
language_style_atoms.description: Use conditional expressions like 'If text were provided', 'assuming' when conclusion is uncertain
examples: If text were provided, I can give you...

content_organization_atoms.name: no_available_content_data
content_organization_atoms.description: All content fields empty; cannot analyze content organization methods

content_organization_atoms.name: step_by_step_progressive_expansion
content_organization_atoms.description: Decompose complex problems into multiple steps, solve sequentially in logical order

content_organization_atoms.name: bullet_point_enumeration
content_organization_atoms.description: Use bullet points to list multiple related items, wide coverage

content_organization_atoms.name: problem_restructure_analysis
content_organization_atoms.description: At the beginning, restate/reformulate the problem to confirm correct understanding
examples: The question asks: What is the main factor...?

content_organization_atoms.name: markdown_heading_structure
content_organization_atoms.description: Use Markdown headers as response opening, header is the central theme

content_organization_atoms.name: conclusion_emphasis_boxing
content_organization_atoms.description: At the end, use bold, box, or special markers to emphasize final answer
examples: boxed{Answer is NO if and only if ...}

content_organization_atoms.name: comparison_framework
content_organization_atoms.description: Use pros/cons or advantages/disadvantages comparison framework for analysis
examples: Advantages vs Disadvantages, Pros and Cons analysis

content_organization_atoms.name: numbered_step_sequence
content_organization_atoms.description: Use numbered lists for step-based content, clear structure

content_organization_atoms.name: example_case_illustration
content_organization_atoms.description: Explain concepts through specific cases or examples

content_organization_atoms.name: answer_first
content_organization_atoms.description: Directly give final answer or conclusion at response opening, then elaborate with explanation

content_organization_atoms.name: table_data_presentation
content_organization_atoms.description: Use Markdown tables to organize and present comparative data or calculation results

content_organization_atoms.name: theoretical_practical_dual
content_organization_atoms.description: Combine theoretical explanation with practical application, equal emphasis on theory and practice
examples: Theory: assumptions and principles -> Practice: implementation

content_organization_atoms.name: table_data_presentation_wide
content_organization_atoms.description: Use tables to present comparative or structured data

content_organization_atoms.name: kpi_metric_specification
content_organization_atoms.description: Response ending includes quantitative metrics and KPI definitions

content_organization_atoms.name: summary_closing
content_organization_atoms.description: At response ending, use summary statements to restate core conclusions
examples: Therefore, Cyril Suk is the correct answer.

content_organization_atoms.name: code_block_with_explanation
content_organization_atoms.description: Code blocks alternate with explanatory text; show code first then explain

content_organization_atoms.name: template_checklist_provision
content_organization_atoms.description: Provide directly usable templates or checklists
examples: Lean Canvas Template, SEO Audit Checklist

content_organization_atoms.name: formula_derivation_display
content_organization_atoms.description: Display complete process of mathematical or logical derivation, including formula transformation and substitution
examples: Q = m x c x DeltaT = 1kg x 4000J/(kg.K) x 20K = 80000J

content_organization_atoms.name: step_by_step_derivation
content_organization_atoms.description: Divide solution process into multiple clear steps, each step numbered sequentially

content_organization_atoms.name: multi_angle_verification
content_organization_atoms.description: Verify same conclusion multiple times using different methods or assumptions
examples: Verification with different assumptions: using DeltaT=16K -> 222 openings

content_organization_atoms.name: section_heading_structure
content_organization_atoms.description: Use Markdown headers (like ## Solution, ### Step 1) to divide response areas

content_organization_atoms.name: unit_conversion_embedding
content_organization_atoms.description: In math problems, first unify units (tons to pounds, hours to minutes) before core calculation

content_organization_atoms.name: code_implementation_supplement
content_organization_atoms.description: After explanation, provide Python or other code implementation as supplement
examples: Here is a complete Python script implementing the solution:

content_organization_atoms.name: complexity_analysis_ending
content_organization_atoms.description: For algorithm problems, provide time and space complexity analysis at the end
examples: Complexity: O(N + L) where N=length, L=max value

content_organization_atoms.name: conditional_branch_explanation
content_organization_atoms.description: During reasoning process, explain conditional branch logic like 'if/otherwise'
examples: if 35% of women are in favor, then 65% are opposed

content_organization_atoms.name: reverse_verification
content_organization_atoms.description: At the end, verify answer correctness through reverse calculation or alternative methods
examples: Verification: Let me verify by finding the original x-intercept first
